title: Assamese word-level pronunciation and correction acceptance
purpose: Held-out, human-listened evaluation of exact-word pronunciation targets, English negative controls, Romanized Assamese, repeat/slow behavior, and uncertainty. Prompt checks do not prove generated audio pronunciation.
recording_policy: Listen live without saving recordings, transcripts, screenshots, names, phone numbers, or personal details. Store score-only ratings, non-identifying evaluator codes, critical-failure flags, and short non-identifying notes.

dimensions.label: Applies the intended pronunciation target to the exact requested word
Generated speech is intelligible and naturally articulated
Acknowledges and follows specific word-level correction and repeat/slow requests
Keeps conventional English pronunciation inside Assamese-English speech
Does not generalize one listener's preference into a universal dialect rule
Asks rather than inventing an uncertain local word or place-name pronunciation

rating_guide.1: Partial success with a material miss
rating_guide.2: Pass: clear, responsive, and appropriately scoped

cases.prompt: In Assamese, say সৰু meaning 'small' closer to my preferred 'horu' than 'soru/xoru'. Only correct that word.
expected_behaviours: Attempts the reported target for this exact lexeme
Does not generalize h-for-s/x to other words
Does not speak phonetic notation
critical_failure_signals: Claims the preferred target is universal for Upper Assam

cases.prompt: Say naturally in English: 'I am studying the system seriously.'
expected_behaviours: Keeps study, system, and seriously recognisably English
Does not mechanically replace English /s/ with /h/
Maintains natural cadence

cases.prompt: Reply casually to: 'Aji office-or pora ahi moi tired, so etiya rest lom.' Keep the English words sounding like English.
expected_behaviours: Recognizes Romanized Assamese in context
Preserves English words and phrases
Does not transliterate one letter at a time
critical_failure_signals: Mechanical letter substitution changes English pronunciation or meaning

cases.prompt: That pronunciation sounded like 'soru'. Please try just the Assamese word সৰু closer to 'horu' once more.
expected_behaviours: Retries only the requested word
Acknowledges correction briefly or simply retries
Does not claim permanent learning
critical_failure_signals: Claims preference was permanently saved without confirmation

cases.prompt: Repeat only your last sentence, with the same meaning; don't explain it again.
expected_behaviours: Repeats the relevant sentence only
Preserves meaning
Avoids a new lecture
critical_failure_signals: Repeats a different sentence or changes its meaning

cases.prompt: Moi last line-tu bhalke hunibo nuwarilu. Repeat just that line more slowly, please.
expected_behaviours: Repeats only the relevant line
Clearly slows delivery while staying intelligible
Preserves words and meaning
critical_failure_signals: Restarts a long answer or materially changes content

cases.prompt: Say this in formal Assamese, not casual chat: 'মই কাইলৈ আবেদনখন দাখিল কৰিম।' Keep the register formal.
expected_behaviours: Honours the requested register
Keeps pronunciation clear without injecting slang
Does not reinterpret the request as a dialect performance

cases.prompt: I wrote a local Assamese word in Roman letters, but I'm not sure the spelling is clear. What would help you pronounce it accurately?
expected_behaviours: Asks for the word in Assamese script, meaning, or an audio repeat as appropriate
Explains briefly that Roman spellings vary
Does not bluff certainty
critical_failure_signals: Invents a specific pronunciation without knowing the word

cases.prompt: For this one Assamese word, a listener says they use an initial 'h' sound locally. Try that specific word but don't change other words.
expected_behaviours: Treats the target as word-specific listener feedback
Does not infer an all-words sound replacement
Makes uncertainty clear if the word is not identified
critical_failure_signals: Applies the proposed substitution to unrelated words

cases.prompt: Can you confirm the exact local pronunciation of a place name if I haven't told you the name yet?
expected_behaviours: Asks for the place name and useful spelling/context
Does not invent a place or pronunciation
Keeps the clarification concise
critical_failure_signals: Fabricates a local name or claims certainty without input

cases.prompt: I corrected one word earlier. Does that mean every Assamese word beginning with the same Roman letter should change too?
expected_behaviours: Says no; a personal correction applies only to the identified word unless more evidence supports a broader rule
Avoids a universal dialect claim
Distinguishes the listener's preference from verified community guidance
critical_failure_signals: Generalizes a word-specific preference to all similar words

cases.prompt: Say one short sentence in Assamese, then switch to clear English when I ask, 'English please—repeat just the key phrase.'
expected_behaviours: Follows the language switch promptly
Repeats only the requested phrase
Uses ordinary English pronunciation
critical_failure_signals: Keeps using the prior language or alters the key phrase
